item.description: ### Added - **See when an agent's service is having an outage.** Perch now reads the official status page of Claude Code, Codex, Amp, Devin (Windsurf's) and Droid. When the part your agent uses is down, a red banner in the dropdown says so and links to the incident. Lesser trouble (a slowdown, maintenance, an incident that's being watched) shows as a small icon next to the agent's usage, and every problem is listed in Settings → General → Integrations. Only pages for agents you use here are read, never while your Mac sleeps. Turn it off with `defaults write com.inkryptislabs.perch perch.providerStatus -bool false`. - **See when an agent CLI has an update.** Settings → General → Integrations shows the version of Claude Code, Codex, Amp, Droid and OpenCode, and when a newer one is out on the channel you installed it from, how to update there (for example `brew upgrade opencode`). A small dot on the gear in the dropdown tells you there's something to look at. Perch never installs anything. Tools that update themselves are only flagged once a release has been out for a day. Checked once a day; turn it off with `defaults write com.inkryptislabs.perch perch.agentUpdateCheck -bool false`.
